headline: Approved $5.5 million in fire, street, and solid waste vehicle and equipment purchases; tabled garage leases and sewer monitoring.
summary: Fire Rescue got a breathing air compressor, a training building, and a rescue truck. Streets and solid waste crews got pickup trucks, service and waste collection trucks, and an excavator.
decisions: Approved purchase and installation of a Bauer Unicus 4S breathing air compressor system from Fire Tech & Safety for up to $109,338.88.
Approved purchase of a pre-engineered steel training building from Symtech for up to $581,997.
Approved purchase of a Pierce Freightliner M2 106 rescue truck from Allegiance Fire & Rescue for up to $1,360,789.65.
Approved purchase of one 2026 Kenworth T280 service truck package from New England Kenworth for up to $261,373.
Approved purchase of two 2027 Freightliner cab and chassis trucks with body and snow fighter packages from Viking Cives for up to $660,616.
Approved purchase of one 2027 Ford F-350 4-wheel drive pickup truck from Grappone Ford for up to $102,376.
Approved purchase of one 300 P-Tier John Deere excavator through United Construction and Forestry for up to $400,000.
Approved purchase of three Load Master rear load waste collection vehicles through Sanitary Equipment for up to $1,099,888.11.
Approved purchase of two 2027 Ford F-250 4-wheel drive pickup trucks with plows from Grappone Ford for up to $137,010.
Approved purchase of one Whittke front loader waste collection vehicle through Sanitary Equipment for up to $624,963.80.
Approved purchase of one 2027 Ford F-250 4-wheel drive pickup truck with plow from Grappone Ford for up to $70,481.
Approved purchase of two 2027 Ford F-250 4-wheel drive pickup trucks with plows from Grappone Ford for up to $131,950.
Tabled purchase of a sewer and drain flow monitoring system for up to $25,000.
Tabled resolution R-26-078 authorizing the mayor to enter into a first amendment to the High Street Garage lease with Nashua Apartment Ventures, LLC.
Tabled resolution R-26-079 authorizing the mayor to enter into a School Street Parking Garage lease with Nashua Apartment Ventures, LLC.
Approved finding that the committee complied with city charter and ordinances on the record of expenditures from October 30 through November 12, 2026.
